# Another Dungeon: rare maps and Rare Horrors

Source: anothereden.wiki, page "Another Dungeon" (saved 2026-11-27, revision 342027), the "Rare
Areas" and "Rare Horrors" tables. Facts only; no game art. How rare maps work (chances,
Horrors only on map 2): [another-dungeon.md](another-dungeon.md#rare-maps). Every dungeon:
[another-dungeon-list.md](another-dungeon-list.md).

A rare map keeps the normal map's layout; only its name differs. A macro that reads the map's
name on screen can tell a normal map from a rare one by these names. The name shown is the one
in the "Map 2 rare name" / "Map 3 rare name" columns.

## Rare map names

50 dungeons. The dungeon column is the page's own wording; the page lists the two Zerberiya
Continent dungeons as "Antiquity Zerberiya Continent: Thunder" and ": Crystal", the same as
[the list](another-dungeon-list.md). A "-" means the page gives no rare name for that map
(only a rare map 2 exists there). Names are spelled as the page shows them, with or without a
dash.

Rare maps drop Memoir items from chests at a higher rate, and some have a Rare Horror (below).

## Rare Horrors

A Rare Horror takes the normal Horror's place, only on a rare map 2, and drops materials only it
drops. Level: the level shown for that difficulty. Weak and resist are the icons the page shows,
written as their names ("wing" is the name of the page's icon; the rest of this knowledge base
calls the same icon wind). A "-" in the rare map 2 column means the page names only the dungeon
for that row; a "-" under weak, resist or drop means the page shows nothing there (Mementos'
Horror has no drop on the page).
